results.title: An artifact whose bytes changed under a stable digest
results.evidence: the bytes under sha256:4cadb37ba59f5b2b… were replaced. `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{digest}/verify` re-hashes and reports intact=False with recomputed sha256:c6b2fe0c1ae01eb7…, and `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{digest}` serves the substituted bytes with 200. That separation is deliberate and documented — re-hashing a multi-gigabyte file on every read is not free — so the control rests entirely on somebody C
